content.comment_body: Hello, About four years ago, I bought 3 [product_name] operator panels that were not used in the project. Yesterday I tried to use them; one worked while the other two did not. I cannot access menus or change their settings, and they won't enter admin mode. I suspect their ROM memory may be lost. What can be done to fix this issue? Thanks.
Can you clarify? Are you unable to enter the password or access certain menus?
The password menu does not appear. The operator panels are newly unpacked from their boxes.
This situation is new to me. I suggest starting a support request.
Hi, Did you enable communication in the [product_name] access control? Have you configured the correct IP address in the operator panel?

Even without a connection to the [product_name], you should be able to select menu items using the cursor right or ENTER keys; that's how it works on my panel. The video you shared indicates this is not possible on your device.

Based on your video, it seems the cursor-right key on your panel is defective. Although the ENTER key can also be used to select, it's not an ideal workaround since different menu contexts require both keys to function properly. You may need to replace the faulty part(s).
It seems that the ENTER key is also not working. In your video, it's clear that both keys are being pressed, yet neither responds. Is it possible for both keys to be defective on two devices?
When I follow the same steps demonstrated in your video on my [product_name] panel, everything works correctly. This leads me to believe the two devices you have are faulty.
On my first-generation panel, everything functions without any issues.

Hello, [company_name] support responded: Dear [user_name], We regret to inform you that we are currently unable to process your request. If you have further questions, feel free to contact us again. Best regards, Your Technical Support for Digital Industries, [user_name], [company_name] AG, Digital Industries, Customer Services DI, Technical Support
[user_name] is from Iran. Due to export laws, we are unable to provide technical support. Support for [product_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users experienced nonfunctional hardware keys on two out of three newly unboxed [product_name] operator devices, making them inaccessible for configuration or menu navigation. Video evidence suggests these failures are due to hardware defects and not user setup issues, raising questions about reliability and longevity of devices stored for extended periods and only recently opened.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect all newly unboxed [product_name] panels to work flawlessly, including full access to menu navigation keys and configuration or administrative settings.
